navigationLaw: Jake wakes beside the real rescued Ethan. The scene explicitly preserves the distinction between memory-image and living brother before the final Armada course is set.

actors.name: C09_04_RealEthan
actors.text: You were gone for a while. I am still here. And I know the last course Voss will trust.

actors.name: C09_04_FinalCourse
actors.title: Course into the Armada
actors.body: Ethan combines the route he was forced to maintain with the false bearings he planted. The result is a physical approach into Draven's final screen.
